description: Organize your chat into Normal, Friends, and MP tabs — filter messages by friend list and quickly reply to specific players without typing full commands. (This is a minecraft mod)

mods.name: FriendChat
mods.description: Add friends and MP tabs to the Minecraft chat, with custom commands to filter and target messages.

releases.notes:
## FriendChat 1.0.0 — Initial Release

First public release of FriendChat! 🎉

### ✨ Features
- **Tabbed chat interface** with three modes: Normal, Friends, and MP
- **Friends tab** — filter chat to only show messages from players on your friends list
- **MP tab** — focus on a single player's messages and reply instantly without retyping commands
- **`/chatfriend`** command to manage your friends list (`add` / `remove`)
- **`/chatmp <player>`** command to focus the MP tab on a specific player
- **`/friendchatconfig`** command to rename any of the mod's commands to your liking
- Persistent config — your friends list and settings are saved between sessions

### 📋 Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.1+
- Fabric API 0.141.6+1.21.11 (or any release for 1.21.11)
- Java 21+

### ⚠️ Notes
- Client-side only — no server-side installation needed
- Renaming a command via `/friendchatconfig` requires a game restart to take effect
